authority.trusted_record_permissions: Regular root-owned files whose immediate parent directories are root-owned and neither file nor parent is group/other writable.

freshness.rule: Ready evidence is valid only for the exact immutable Care candidate source revision, Care source tree, package version, exact package SHA-256, and representative target it names. Any source, package, recovery-script, dependency, or target-environment change invalidates prior ready evidence until lifecycle acceptance and governed promotion are repeated.

failure_behavior.summary_rule: The Care continuity summary must never be more favorable than any required exact-candidate restore-capability evidence. Missing, failed, stale, mismatched, malformed, writable, or otherwise untrusted lifecycle/governance evidence blocks ready.

restore_capability: Exact candidate Debian package installs and passes scripts/validate-installed.sh on the representative supported target.
Candidate removal succeeds and package-owned executable, helper, policy, desktop, icon, metadata, exact-source provenance file, and package-owned provenance directory are absent afterward.
Exact candidate reinstalls and passes installed validation.
A retained previous Development package can be installed with an explicit downgrade and the previous runtime/report path remains functional.
The exact candidate can be restored after downgrade and passes installed validation again.
Final installed state matches the exact candidate package version and package-owned source revision/source tree.
Care-owned representative-target evidence records the exact candidate package SHA-256 but leaves both Everkeep promotion flags false.
A separate Everkeep-owned governance record matches the Care target record source identity and exact package SHA-256 and explicitly promotes both integration and readiness.
migration: Upgrade and downgrade behavior is exercised for the exact candidate against a retained prior Development package.
Care continues to persist no substantial application-owned user dataset requiring a separate data migration.
documentation: RECOVERY.md documents irreversible maintenance boundaries and package rollback behavior.
RELEASE-ACCEPTANCE.md records the exact-candidate recovery, provenance, governance, and rollback qualification gate.
contracts/continuity.status.schema.json validates the machine-readable continuity-state boundary.
provenance: Exact source revision and Care source tree are embedded in package-owned root-controlled build provenance.
Exact Debian package SHA-256 is recorded externally by representative acceptance and matches the governed Everkeep record.
Exact CI workflow run and retained artifact identity are recorded during release qualification.
The accepted package is built from the GoreeCloud/goreecloud-zorin-os Care component authority.
Untracked package inputs are rejected so working-tree glob expansion cannot escape the committed source identity.
